name: Harness Guardrails
description: Opt-in finalize quality gate and plan-first nudge for autonomous agent turns.

qualityCheck.enabled.label: Quality Gate
qualityCheck.enabled.help: Run the configured changed-file checks before an autonomous turn finalizes; revise on failure. Off by default.

qualityCheck.command.label: Quality Command
qualityCheck.command.help: Command run in the workspace to check changed files. Defaults to 'pnpm check:changed'.

applyTo.triggers.label: Applies To Triggers
applyTo.triggers.help: Agent run triggers the guardrails apply to. Defaults to ['cron'] so interactive turns are untouched.

plan.mode.label: Plan Nudge
plan.mode.help: When 'prompt', inject a plan-first / check-before-commit directive into in-scope turns.
